children: , the global payments network, began settling SoFi Bank card transactions using SoFiUSD, while its shares holds flat at $565.21 at 11.38am ET time on Friday. The launch puts a bank-issued stablecoin to work inside an operating card program. Investors barely moved Mastercard's stock.

SoFi says the program is expected to handle more than $25 billion in annualized card volume. That is the size of the card program, not a reported total for stablecoin transactions or new Mastercard revenue. Merchants can receive funds without holding tokens or building blockchain systems, which gives the arrangement a better shot at fitting into everyday payments.

The picture shows Mastercard trading 17.49% below its $685 GF Value estimate. That gap may catch an investor's eye, but it does not tell us what this deal will earn. Mastercard's real opportunity is to keep its network central as the asset used for settlement changes. The proof will come from faster or cheaper settlement, wider adoption and, eventually, measurable revenue.

title: Mastercard Stock Holds Flat as $25 Billion Stablecoin Settlement Goes Live
